meta.basis: The Creed is said by the priest together with the people, everyone standing; 'at the words et incarnatus est, etc. (and by the Holy Spirit . . . and became man) all make a profound bow' (GIRM 137, 43, 68), the rubric the Order of Mass prints at those lines. The card shows that bow, at the very words of the excerpt.
